nodes.label: ADR-002: Frontend Timezone Decoding and Fixed-Offset Boundaries
nodes.rationale: The Date-to-Temporal shift exposed timezone regressions from re-decoding at call sites and drifting offset reconstruction across scheduling, plugin, and export paths.

nodes.label: Centralized Timezone Decoding
nodes.rationale: Persisted timezone decoding lives in src/utils/timezone_utils.ts; fixed-offset reconstruction stays aligned across scheduling, plugin, and export boundaries and normalized timezone data is consumed, not rederived.
